{… |s}.description: Variable with the |s flag. Suppress escaping of HTML entities.

{… |p}.description: Variable with the |p flag. Render the variable, but do not parse its contents.

<!--# … -->.description: Escape comment. Render markup as text.

<!--! … -->.description: Server-side comment. Stripped at the compilation stage.

{! … !}.description: Server-side comment. Stripped at the compilation stage.

<inline css>.description: <inline> element. Render a variable's contents as inline CSS.

<inline js>.description: <inline> element. Render a variable's contents as inline JS.

<include …> with <arg …>.description: <include> element with an <arg> argument. Import external templates.

<include …> as a web component.description: <include> element rendered as a web component. Import external templates.

<include …> as a web component with <arg.description: <include> element rendered as a web component with an <arg> argument. Import external templates.

<include …> as a hydrating web component.description: <include> element rendered as a web component that is sent the model keys it names. Import external templates.

<arg …>.description: <include> <arg> argument. The argument name is required.

<if …>.description: <if> block. Check for the presence of something.

<if …=\"…\">.description: <if> block. Check the value of something.

<unless …>.description: <unless> block. Check for the non-presence of something.

<elseunless …>.description: <elseunless> block. Check for the non-presence of something.

<if … and …>.description: <if> block using the 'and' boolean logic operator.

<if … or …>.description: <if> block using the 'or' boolean logic operator.

<if … xor …>.description: <if> block using the 'xor' boolean logic operator.

<if not:…>.description: <if> block using the 'not:' boolean logic prefix.

if-….description: One-line version of <if>. Checks for the presence of something.

if-…=\"…\".description: One-line version of <if>. Checks the value of something.

<loop …>.description: <loop> block. Loop through an array or object of data.

<loop …> with key.description: <loop> block with a key attribute. Loop through an array or object of data.

selected-value.description: selected-value attribute. Select the matching <option> element in a <select> field.

checked-value.description: checked-value attribute. Check the matching checkbox or radio button.

<noteddy>.description: <noteddy> block. Skip parsing a block of code.

<noparse>.description: <noparse> block. Skip parsing a block of code.

<pre parse>.description: <pre> block with a parse attribute. Parse a block of code that would otherwise be skipped.
